actions: **Prioritize Sleep Duration**: Aim for consistent 7-9 hours of sleep nightly, as your current average of 6h 18m is hindering full recovery and reducing vital deep and REM sleep cycles.

**Enhance Sleep Quality**: Implement a consistent bedtime routine and optimize your sleep environment to improve sleep efficiency, particularly on days where scores drop significantly (e.g., 41 on May 30th).

**Boost Body Battery Recovery**: Focus on winding down activities an hour before bed to allow your Body Battery to fully recharge beyond the current 20.9 average low, ensuring more complete overnight restoration.

**Monitor Evening Habits**: Observe your evening routines and potential stressors, especially before days with low sleep scores and HRV dips (e.g., 77 on May 31st), to identify and mitigate negative impacts on recovery.

By prioritizing more restorative sleep, you will unlock greater recovery, enhance performance, and maintain your overall health trajectory.
